verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, so team conversation assignment is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows assigning conversations to teammates or any explicit ownership model. The only related item is a bare 'Filters & Rules' help-article title, which is generic mail filtering rather than routing mail to teammates, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
